gen-almendra-display-gf-georama: Georama reads wide and friendly, its c opened like a bracelet pulled apart and its capitals barely rising above the lowercase. Almendra Display handles the ornate, literary flourish; Georama simply gets on with being approachable.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-julius-sans-on: Julius Sans One spaces its letters far apart, with curves left open at the ends and capitals barely taller than the small letters. Red Hat Display's marker-like line is the strongest thing here.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-stint-ultra-expanded: Confident and tightly knit, Oswald packs its rows close and strong. And Stint Ultra Expanded, a text serif, lets each character float apart with open counters and a traditional, authoritative feel.
gen-almendra-display-gf-gidole: Gidole reads neutral and clean, with terminals held apart like open scissor blades and a midline set high. Then Almendra Display gives the page its ornate, literary side, with shading that Gidole never attempts.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-lexend-exa: Lexend Exa reads professional and clean, with stubby ascenders and descenders beside a big x-height and curves that stay clearly open. And a longer passage in it would move steadily, every stroke the same thickness from any angle.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-bhutuka-expanded-one: Confident is the mood Oswald brings, with tightly knit rows of text and strokes that stay blunt where they meet. BhuTuka Expanded One slows the pace to a leisurely walk with curvy, literary letters, so give it a little extra room.
gen-almendra-display-gf-golos-text: Letters that never seem to pinch shut give Almendra Display its ornate, literary character, with calligraphic shading in the strokes. But Golos Text is the sans that fills the line with a tall x-height and a single stroke width.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-lexend-giga: Red Hat Display draws a bold, marker-like line with daylight inside each curve, and its lowercase sits moderately tall. And Lexend Giga follows with flat linework and generous tracking, so every word opens out.
gen-almendra-display-gf-hedvig-letters-s: Ornate and literary, Almendra Display never lets its letters pinch shut, while Hedvig Letters Sans is the sans with small letters nearly as tall as capitals. Paragraphs would feel approachable and open.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-lexend-mega: Red Hat Display sets a bold, constant-width line with visible daylight inside every curve, and Lexend Mega answers with a body height that nearly matches the capitals. Both stay open and modern.
